authority: Owner-approved horizontal 7-donor 22-row 5-divider sample — FORMAT only; no mapping acceptance.

dataContract.sourceOfTruth: single versioned structured set of donorColumns, sectionDividers, proposedDimRows, evidenceCells and disposition; output mirrors generated from that one set

master.headerCellContent: source donor original display labels, in canonical sample order, then PROPOSED DIM ELEMENT

sections.markdownRow: <tr><th colspan='8'>section title</th></tr> in sample-mode; colspan derives from actual donor count+1
sections.csvRow: section title in first donor column, all remaining columns empty; not a concept row
sections.order: source JSON rows order; do not alphabetize before owner review

donorCells.rejectedAndHeld: RENDER_BLANK_IN_MASTER; retain source and decision in evidence sheet

tabs.name: Master Crosswalk
tabs.purpose: approved horizontal owner-facing comparison; not an Excel structured Table because merged section rows

tabs.name: Evidence
tabs.purpose: one source-cited evidence record for each populated donor cell and rejected/held comparisons

tabs.name: DIM Definitions
tabs.purpose: row keys, proposed terms, definitions, concept kinds and review disposition

tabs.name: Donor Sources
tabs.purpose: source edition, column roster, source availability, original publisher and rank calculation inputs

tabs.name: Read Me
tabs.purpose: plain-language meanings, blank/≈ legend, version, evidence and source limitations

freeze.note: Excel cannot freeze only the rightmost column while leaving left-side columns scrollable; preserve DIM-last geometry and horizontal scroll.

filtering.note: Do not apply a structured Excel table/AutoFilter over full-width merged section headings; filtering is available in supporting sheets.

workbook.citationPolicy: No self-certification. Original source URLs/edition/locator and source verification recorded in Evidence, accessible by row/donor key and optional internal hyperlink/comment in master.

webView.sectionDividers: true full-width HTML table rows using colspan
webView.notes: GitHub table may be wide; preserve scroll/semantic structure rather than convert donors to vertical list

restrictions: Do not edit approved 22-row sample or prior donor corpus
Do not merge all 46 potential donor columns into actual master
Do not finalize least-to-most donor ranking
Do not generate XLSX in Step05
Do not change DIM, UML, CSAPI Profile, application, server or Cloudflare
